core_competencies.name: Communication & Influence
core_competencies.definition: Interacting with others openly and effectively demonstrating accuracy, transparency, and clarity.

1: Can express own perspective clearly and concisely
Listens to others and uses relevant questions to gather information
Explains and justifies point of view objectively
Body language is appropriate and consistent with non-verbal messages
2: Focuses on the issues and conveys the meaning concisely and effectively
Is accessible and gives others time to fully express their thoughts
Actively seeks to influence others before a decision is made
Prevents arguments and ensures focus is maintained throughout discussions
3: Uses simple language to effectively convey complex issues
Balances speaking with listening; encourages involvement of others
Utilizes chains of indirect influence and designs tactics to promote ideas
Responds positively and professionally to questions and challenges
4: Role models effective and persuasive communication strategies
Uses in-depth understanding of the person or organization to influence
Uses in-depth understanding of group dynamics to achieve objectives

core_competencies.name: Collaboration & Teamwork
core_competencies.definition: Communicating within and across groups to create alignment and share information.

1: Demonstrates respect for others and works productively with a broad range of individuals
Acts to promote the team, organization and its goals
Shares information and own expertise with others
Values and acknowledges the input and know-how of other team members
2: Communicates a clear vision of team goals and objectives
Creates an environment in which team members share both risks and rewards
Focuses the team's efforts on both the process and desired outcome
Acknowledges diverse views and works towards consensus-based solutions
3: Facilitates formation of cross-functional and cross-departmental teams
Demonstrates personal commitment to the maintenance of relationships
Encourages collaboration by constructing clear team objectives
Removes barriers and fosters collaboration across teams
4: Develops and fosters opportunities to enhance outcomes through partnerships and alliances
Encourages and negotiates sharing of information and skills across organization
Develops processes that give credit and recognition to teams
Drives a culture in which people are treated fairly and equitably

1.name: Adaptability
1.definition: Adjusting own behaviours to work efficiently and effectively in light of new information, changing situations and/or different environments.
indicators: Seeks guidance in adapting behaviour to the needs of a new or different situation
Works actively in different work conditions, places, time and circumstances
Adheres to all Al Esraa's rules, systems, procedures and framework religiously, even if against one's personal interest

1.name: Punctuality & Accountability
1.definition: Understands and outwardly expresses responsibility for timeliness, commitment to task, adherence to performance standards, and conformity with the rules and policies of an organization.
indicators: Follows rules and expectations for work attendance and performance as defined, written, and implemented by Al Esraa
Provides advance notice of intended absence and/or Tardiness
Perseveres through various working conditions to complete tasks

1.name: Health & Safety Awareness
1.definition: The extent of one's knowledge, understanding, adherence to and implementation of health and safety laws, regulations, and other occupational standards for the purpose of establishing, promoting, and maintaining a safe work environment for oneself and others.
indicators: Carefully organizes the personal workspace/assigned work environment to minimize the likelihood of an accident or other unsafe incidents
Consistently adheres to detailed procedural instructions to carry out work activities safely

1.name: Taking Initiative & Drive for Results
1.definition: Taking action, proactively doing things. The time frame of this scale moves from addressing current opportunities or problems to being proactive.
indicators: Is energetic and applies self to the task at hand
Demonstrates a 'can do' attitude to the delivery of KPI's
Accepts ambitious targets and invests energy to deliver these
Is committed to deadlines and timelines
Persists and adopts different approaches if initial attempts are not successful

2.name: Taking Initiative & Drive for Results
2.definition: Displays responsiveness and determination to complete the task to quality expectations, within the allocated timeframe and constantly tries to improve own and/or the team's performance.
indicators: Displays responsiveness and determination to complete the task to quality expectations, within the allocated timeframe
Constantly tries to improve own and/or the team's performance
Acts quickly and decisively in a time-sensitive situation
Monitors and measures key performance indicators, takes remedial action where required
Identifies future problems, communicates these and takes proactive steps to moderate or eliminate them
Shows willingness to work overtime in order to meet set deadlines

2.name: Continuous Learning
2.definition: Identifying and addressing individual strengths and weaknesses, developmental needs and changing circumstances to enhance personal performance.
indicators: Continually self-assesses and seeks feedback from others to identify strengths and weaknesses and ways of improving
Consistently relies on himself in implementing self-development plans and actions
Pursues learning opportunities and on-going development
Takes advantage of learning opportunities (e.g., courses, observation of others, assignments, etc.)
Integrates new learning into work methods

2.name: Punctuality & Accountability
2.definition: Understands and outwardly expresses responsibility for timeliness, commitment to task, adherence to performance standards, and conformity with the rules and policies of an organization.
indicators: Follows set procedures and rules
Takes appropriate measures to address group/team shortcomings
Shows willingness to work overtime in order to meet set deadlines

2.name: Health & Safety Awareness
2.definition: The extent of one's knowledge, understanding, adherence to and implementation of health and safety laws, regulations, and other occupational standards for the purpose of establishing, promoting, and maintaining a safe work environment for oneself and others.
indicators: Carefully organizes the personal workspace/assigned work environment to minimize the likelihood of an accident or other unsafe incidents
Consistently adheres to detailed procedural instructions to carry out work activities safely

3.name: Coaching & Leading Others
3.definition: Encouraging performance and coaching others, in order to fulfil the current and future skill requirements of both individuals within the profession and the organization. Providing inspiration, motivational support, clarity and direction; through a compelling vision of the future.
indicators: Identifies or suggests activities that could help others develop new technical skills
Coaches others by providing feedback relative to learning new competencies
Reassures and/or expresses positive expectations for future performance when giving corrective feedback and/or after a setback
Generates excitement, enthusiasm and commitment in people
Leads by example; and aligns own behaviour with Al Esraa's vision and values. Is seen by others as a role model and credible leader

3.name: Supervision
3.definition: Supervising, giving feedback and coaching others; evaluating people and performance; disciplining and counselling, and building positive relationships.
indicators: Provides on-going feedback and performance reviews on time
Supports the development of subordinates by providing ways and tools to improve their skills and competencies
Addresses team performance problems and issues promptly; lets people know what is expected of them
Recognizes and encourages behaviours that contribute to teamwork

3.name: Initiation
3.definition: The extent to which one independently anticipates and identifies problems, obstacles and opportunities and takes action to address impediments and capitalize on opportunities to achieve performance targets.
indicators: Thinks ahead and effectively prepares and organizes resources and activities
Makes sure things aren't left to chance; ensures sufficient follow-up to check on progress, uncover potential problems and identify areas where support/assistance might be needed
Anticipates and prepares for problems that may interfere with work or attainment of results

3.name: Problem Solving & Decision Making
3.definition: Making effective and informed decisions; and solving problems involving varied levels of complexity, ambiguity and risk.
indicators: Is able to consider information from multiple perspectives
Has the confidence to take decisions and be accountable for mistakes
Takes time to consider the short and long term outcomes and actions to ensure all risks are calculated
Collaborates with the team to make sound decisions by gathering input and feedback from others

4.name: Results Orientation
4.definition: Focusing personal efforts on achieving results consistent with the organization's objectives.
indicators: Guides staff to achieve smart objectives and performance standards
Evaluates others based on set and communicated KPIs
Focuses on agreed targets and pushes for improved results in area of responsibility
Takes on new roles and responsibilities when faced with unexpected changes to achieve planned objectives

4.name: Problem Solving & Decision Making
4.definition: Making effective and informed decisions; and solving problems involving varied levels of complexity, ambiguity and risk.
indicators: Uses several analytical techniques to assess complex problems and solutions
Creates new concepts that are not obvious to others and not learned from previous experience
Explains problems and decisions to others to enable them to fully understand and learn
Uses original and innovative thinking to find new and long-term solutions

4.name: Visioning & Strategic Thinking
4.definition: Linking long-range visions and concepts to daily work, ranging from a simple understanding to a sophisticated awareness of the impact of the world on strategies and on choices.
indicators: Foresees obstacles and opportunities for Al Esraa (with a long-term horizon) and acts accordingly
Defines issues, generates opinions and selects solutions that are aligned with Al Esraa strategy and vision
Scans, seeks out, assesses and reports on information potential for future directions
Provides direction and communicates the vision and goals to encourage alignment with Al Esraa strategy
Energetically and persistently promotes strategic objectives with direct reports

4.name: Conflict Management
indicators: Provides consultation to or obtains consultation/mediation for those who are in conflict situation, share few common interests and/or having a significant disagreement
Introduces innovative strategies for effectively dealing with conflict (e.g., mediation, collaborative and 'mutual gains' strategies)

2: Acquires and applies knowledge and new skills as necessary to keep current in field

Understands when provided guidelines are not appropriate to a specific assignment or scenario and is able to consider alternatives
